promotions.title: All-You-Can-Eat Wings
promotions.body: Bone-in wings and your choice of side, all night long.
promotions.finePrint: Dine-in requires a beverage purchase. Prices vary by location — contact your location. Takeout pack available Wednesdays only. Plus applicable taxes.
promotions.source: wackys.com/features and wackys.com/AYCE (via Design System + search index), Oct 2026

promotions.title: Kids Eat Free
promotions.body: Kids 10 and under eat free with an adult — one kids meal per adult entrée.
promotions.finePrint: Dine-in with an adult. One free kids meal per adult entrée. Ask your server for full details. Participating locations only.
promotions.quote: Your weekend is so busy and then the kids say, ‘I'm hungry!’
promotions.source: wackys.com/features (via Design System + search index), Oct 2026

promotions.title: Half Price Games
promotions.body: All games half off — arcade, tabletop, air hockey, VR and billiards.
promotions.quote: Whoever said that winning or losing doesn't matter clearly hasn't set foot in Wacky's.
promotions.source: wackys.com/features (via Design System + search index), Oct 2026

promotions.title: Eat 'N Game On! Combos
promotions.body: Pick a meal — 7 Wing Meal, Build Your Own Smashburger, 3 Jumbo Chicken Tenders or Large Bacon Cheddar Poutine — and add game play.
promotions.finePrint: Three combo tiers. Inclusions per tier vary — confirm with your location. Participating locations only.
promotions.source: Wacky's Design System menu-list component (from wackys.com), Oct 2026
